summary_1line: Rama leads his allies up Mount Suvela to camp and survey the fortified city of Lanka before the coming battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama, bow in hand, climbs the lush slopes of Mount Suvela with Lakshmana, Sugriva, and the monkey army surging up the mountain behind him.
From the summit of Mount Suvela, Rama and his companions gaze across the sea at the glittering, rampart‑encircled city of Lanka.
